['Peek & Cloppenburg KG '].company_description: Peek & Cloppenburg is an international chain of fashion stores from Germany, operated by two separate and independent companies, Peek & Cloppenburg KG Düsseldorf (known as P&C West) and Peek & Cloppenburg KG Hamburg (known as P&C North).

['Takata Europe GmbH '].company_description: Takata Europe GmbH is a company involved in the production of safety system products widely used in aviation and other commercial fields. The company is committed to addressing global health needs through vaccine development against infectious diseases.
